verdict.rationale: Fireflies documents its own outbound webhooks. The uploadAudio mutation accepts a webhook URL that is notified when transcription completes, and a Super Admin webhook notifies about all team meetings for workflow automation. A webhooks-v2 doc is also referenced, used in the Zapier integration. The evidence shows only a narrow event surface (meeting or transcription completion) and no detail on registration, payloads, event types or delivery guarantees, so coverage is partial. missing for 10: a documented catalog of subscribable event types, registration/management API details, payload schema and signature verification, retry/delivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: URL for the webhook that receives notifications when transcription completes

A Super Admin webhook notifies you of all team meetings owned by your team, allowing you to automate workflows, integrate with other tools, and maintain an overview of your team's meetings with a single webhook.
Connect Fireflies [webhooks](https://docs.fireflies.ai/graphql-api/webhooks-v2.md) to Zapier to automatically fetch transcripts when meetings are processed.
